question: In the stream results of the isoprene recovery process simulation, what mass flow rate and isoprene mass fraction does stream 17 have?
rendered: The stream results are on page 4 of the excerpt. Stream 17 has a mass flow rate of 1.084 kg h−1 and an isoprene mass fraction of 9.757 × 10−1.
